title: Pocket checks & brain dump
content:
Top-3 for today (must do):
- finish review of PR 287 (focus: kv cache eviction docstrings). leave inline suggestions.
- quick smoke deploy to staging for canary window (today 2–3pm). coordinate with SRE.
- submit expense for MLOps conference travel (receipts in phone).

Two-minute wins:
- ping Alyssa re: rollout freeze window (ask if 2am option is okay).
- update AWS billing tag on test pool to 'private-demo-03'.
- add 'session-affinity' header note to INF-4212.

Errands / personal:
- buy black printer toner (HP 12A) — office or Amazon? quick compare: office cheaper w/ shipping delay.
- pick up replacement key fob at locksmith (estimate 30min).
- meal prep: roast veggies + chicken, enough for 3 lunches.

Work quick hits (brain dump):
- batcher tuning: try batch_size 8 then 16 for median seq len 128; measure p99.
- idea: soft-affinity routing to keep same model variant for repeated session tokens -> reduces KV misses on short lived chats. sketch on whiteboard.
- note: watch out for tokenization differences when swapping quantized weights (BPE edge cases).

Followups / reminders:
- follow up with CS on customer-reported latency bump (ticket #CS-997). attach timeline + traces.
- mention to product: add 'preferred region' flag to private deploy signup form.
- file confluence draft for 'canary rollback playbook' by EOW. link: confluence: CANARY-PLAYBOOK (draft).

Pomodoro plan (if deep work window):
- 25/5 x 4 for PR + staging, then 15m break, then 2x25 for docs.

Random notes-to-self (short fragments):
- possible perf regression after kernel swap 3/10 — reproduce with perf harness.
- check infra cost report: dedicated pool #D-11 overbudget by 12% (why?).
- remind to move personal laptop backup to encrypted HSM before private demo.

End-of-day quick check:
- did I merge PR comments? -> yes/no
- did staging canary run? -> notes in slack
- receipts uploaded? -> expense submitted

If time: sketch rollout diagram + sequence for multi-model fallback (variants A->B->lite).

-- Noah (quick pocket checklist, messy; clean up into proper PR notes later)
